title: More mushrooms
description: Adds 14 variations of mushrooms and 2 retextures of old ones, they also look different in the inventory.
body:
Wow! now you will no longer see the old ugly mushrooms in the world. I have added 14 new variations and redrawn the old ones so that they look more like their irl versions but do not get too out of the Minecraft style. I am going to update this texture pack and want to add later several variations of the same mushrooms, for example, fly agaric with different numbers of dots, chanterelles of different shapes and stages. the growth of a raw tooth of different colors and so on
